recipes.label: To Remember
recipes.startdescription: Once again bathed in a familiar yet alien light. I shall remember this moment, no matter the reason. [This refreshes this card's duration.]
recipes.description: Perhaps one day it will grant me a reward.

recipes.label: Order My followers to gather supplies
recipes.startdescription:
Given the current situation, this task is perilous and difficult, but I will convince them it is necessary.

[This will consume this card and grant you a certain amount of Supplies.]
recipes.description: It seems I won’t be seeing them for a while. But these can serve a greater purpose.

recipes.label: Command This Unit to Further Scout the Area
recipes.startdescription:
Conduct a thorough, carpet‑style search for those potential opportunities I may have missed.

[This will cause this card to degrade into an Opportunity and grant you some relatively uncommon resources.]
recipes.description: Gains have been made—but before the next mission, I must resupply them.

recipes.label: Planning the Path Ahead in London
recipes.startdescription: I have accomplished the objectives I set for this place. Where can I continue advancing my plans?
recipes.description: Another destination. Another stepping stone paving the Path toward Dawn.
